info.name: Catchpoint REST API v2.0 Account Folder API
Return properties of one or more folders based on folder IDs.

params.name: folderIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of folder IDs to look up

params.name: showInheritedProperties
params.description: Flag to set to see inherited properties as part of the folder properties returned

items.docs:
Results include properties from all sections available in the UI: folder Properties, Advanced Settings, Requests, Insights, Targeting & Scheduling, and Alerts.

Assigning “0” to Folder ID would return the payload to create a new product.

params.name: includeAdvanceSettings
params.description: Include advanced settings section of the folder in the response

params.name: includeRequest
params.description: Include request settings sections of the folder in the response

params.name: includeInsight
params.description: Include insights section of the folder in the response

params.name: includeTargeting
params.description: Include targeting and scheduling section of the folder in the response

params.name: includeAlerts
params.description: Include alerts section of the folder in the response

params.name: pageNumber
params.description: Page number to return records from when the number of records exceeds pageSize

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The number of records that can be returned per page. Maximum value is 100.

params.name: showInheritedProperties
params.description: Represents if inherited properties should be shown

items.docs: All parameters are optional, and you may include any of them to customize the query. To pass multiple values for a parameter, provide a comma-separated list. If no parameters are passed, then details for all active folders are returned. Results include properties from all sections available in the UI: folder Properties, Advanced Settings, Requests, Insights, Targeting & Scheduling, and Alerts. info.name: Create a new folder per the request body.

params.name: objectDetails
params.description: Set to true to return the created object in the response body, otherwise the response body will only return the created object ID.

items.docs:

info.name: Update a property of an existing folder.

params.name: folderId
params.description: Folder ID of the folder to be updated

params.name: objectDetails
params.description: Set to true to return the updated object in the response body, otherwise the response body will only return the updated object ID.

items.docs:
Only the property to be updated can be passed in the request body (do not pass the whole object.) The update request body requires a total of three keys to be filled with appropriate value as listed below:
* **value** – The value property provides the new value.

* **path** – The path property indicates the element to update. The entire path with slashes needs to be provided here. Example: /status/id
